FFmpeg WebAssembly Core — Third-Party Software Notice
=====================================================

This application distributes @ffmpeg/core version 0.12.10, the single-thread
FFmpeg WebAssembly core used by @ffmpeg/ffmpeg.

Package:  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ffmpeg/core/v/0.12.10
Project:  https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
